description: Live. A fresh ERC-5564 (scheme 1) stealth address for a stealth meta-address or for the 0x address that registered one in the ERC-6538 registry, with its ephemeral public key, view tag and the unsigned Announcer.announce transaction to send after paying. Optional token and amount go into the announcement's metadata. Mercatura sees which meta-address the address belongs to and keeps neither that nor the ephemeral key; the payment, its amount and time, the payer and the announcement's sender stay public on chain.

amount.description: A decimal amount in the token's own units, like "25" or "0.5".

from.description: Optional: the wallet that will pay and announce.

registrant.description: Or: the address that registered a meta-address in the ERC-6538 registry.

token.description: USDG, ETH, WETH, or a stock token symbol (SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, SPCX, PLTR, COIN, MSTR, GME).

name: stealth_address
title: Stealth payouts: a one-time address
